   193→/* ===== CARD STACK ===== */
   194→
   195→/** Build a single card element and append it to cs-cards. */
   196→function buildCard({ type, label, text, meta }) {
   197→    const words    = text.trim().split(/\s+/);
   198→    const preview  = words.slice(0, 15).join(' ') + (words.length > 15 ? '…' : '');
   199→
   200→    const card = document.createElement('div');
   201→    card.className = 'cs-card';
   202→    card.dataset.type = type;
   203→    card.setAttribute('role', 'listitem');
   204→
   205→    card.innerHTML = `
   206→      <div class="cs-card-header" role="button" tabindex="0"
   207→           aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="cs-body-${type}">
   208→        <span class="cs-card-label">${escapeHtml(label)}</span>
   209→        <span class="cs-card-preview">${escapeHtml(preview)}</span>
   210→        <span class="cs-card-chevron" aria-hidden="true">
   211→          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
   212→               stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
   213→            <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/>
   214→          </svg>
   215→        </span>
   216→      </div>
   217→      <div class="cs-card-body" id="cs-body-${type}" role="region">
   218→        <div class="cs-card-body-inner">
   219→          <div class="cs-card-meta">
   220→            ${meta.map(m => `<span>${escapeHtml(m)}</span>`).join('')}
   221→          </div>
   222→          <div class="cs-card-text">${escapeHtml(text)}</div>
   223→          <div class="cs-card-actions">
   224→            <button class="cs-action-btn" data-action="readability" disabled>Readability</button>
   225→            <button class="cs-action-btn" data-action="inspire" disabled>Inspire</button>
   226→            <button class="cs-action-btn" data-action="copy" disabled>Copy</button>
   227→            <button class="cs-action-btn" data-action="send" disabled>Send</button>
   228→          </div>
   229→        </div>
   230→      </div>
   231→    `;
   232→
   233→    const header = card.querySelector('.cs-card-header');
   234→
   235→    function toggleCard() {
   236→        const isExpanded = card.classList.contains('cs-expanded');
   237→        // Collapse all other cards (accordion)
   238→        csCards.querySelectorAll('.cs-card.cs-expanded').forEach(c => {
   239→            if (c !== card) {
   240→                c.classList.remove('cs-expanded');
   241→                c.querySelector('.cs-card-header').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
   242→            }
   243→        });
   244→        card.classList.toggle('cs-expanded', !isExpanded);
   245→        header.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!isExpanded));
   246→    }
   247→
   248→    header.addEventListener('click', toggleCard);
   249→    header.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
   250→        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); toggleCard(); }
   251→    });
   252→
   253→    return card;
   254→}
   255→
   256→/** Formats milliseconds as "m:ss" duration string. */
   257→function formatDuration(ms) {
   258→    const totalSecs = Math.round(ms / 1000);
   259→    const mins = Math.floor(totalSecs / 60);
   260→    const secs = totalSecs % 60;
   261→    return `${mins}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`;
   262→}
   263→
   264→/** Show the Card Stack view with the given brainstorm transcript. */
   265→function showCardStack(text, durationMs) {
   266→    // Clear previous cards
   267→    csCards.innerHTML = '';
   268→
   269→    const wordCount = text.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
   270→    const durationStr = durationMs > 0 ? formatDuration(durationMs) : null;
   271→    const meta = [
   272→        durationStr ? `${durationStr}` : null,
   273→        `${wordCount} word${wordCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`,
   274→    ].filter(Boolean);
   275→
   276→    const card = buildCard({ type: 'transcript', label: 'Transcript', text, meta });
   277→    csCards.appendChild(card);
   278→
   279→    // Start expanded since it's the only card
   280→    card.classList.add('cs-expanded');
   281→    card.querySelector('.cs-card-header').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
   282→
   283→    // Slide in
   284→    cardStackView.hidden = false;
   285→    // Force a reflow so the transition fires
   286→    void cardStackView.offsetWidth;
   287→    cardStackView.classList.add('cs-visible');
   288→}
   289→
   290→/** Hide the Card Stack view and return to main screen. */
   291→function hideCardStack() {
   292→    cardStackView.classList.remove('cs-visible');
   293→    // Wait for the slide-out animation, then hide
   294→    cardStackView.addEventListener('transitionend', function onEnd() {
   295→        cardStackView.removeEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);
   296→        cardStackView.hidden = true;
   297→        csCards.innerHTML = '';

   273→/** Show the Card Stack view with the given brainstorm transcript. */
   274→function showCardStack(text, durationMs) {
   275→    // Clear previous cards and reset streaming flag
   276→    csCards.innerHTML = '';
   277→    csIsStreaming = false;
   278→
   279→    const wordCount = text.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
   280→    const durationStr = durationMs > 0 ? formatDuration(durationMs) : null;
   281→    const meta = [
   282→        durationStr ? `${durationStr}` : null,
   283→        `${wordCount} word${wordCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`,
   284→    ].filter(Boolean);
   285→
   286→    const card = buildCard({ type: 'transcript', label: 'Transcript', text, meta });
   287→    csCards.appendChild(card);
   288→
   289→    // Start expanded since it's the only card
   290→    card.classList.add('cs-expanded');
   291→    card.querySelector('.cs-card-header').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
   292→
   293→    // Wire up action buttons and enable them
   294→    setupCardActionHandlers(card);
   295→    updateCardActionStates();
   296→
   297→    // Slide in
   298→    cardStackView.hidden = false;
   299→    // Force a reflow so the transition fires
   300→    void cardStackView.offsetWidth;
   301→    cardStackView.classList.add('cs-visible');
   302→}
   303→
   304→/** Hide the Card Stack view and return to main screen. */
   305→function hideCardStack() {
   306→    cardStackView.classList.remove('cs-visible');
   307→    // Wait for the slide-out animation, then hide
   308→    cardStackView.addEventListener('transitionend', function onEnd() {
   309→        cardStackView.removeEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);
   310→        cardStackView.hidden = true;
   311→        csCards.innerHTML = '';
   312→    }, { once: true });
   313→}
   314→
   315→/** Immediately hide the card stack without animation (used when recording restarts). */
   316→function hideCardStackInstant() {
   317→    cardStackView.classList.remove('cs-visible');
   318→    cardStackView.hidden = true;
   319→    csCards.innerHTML = '';
   320→}
   321→
   322→csBackBtn.addEventListener('click', hideCardStack);
   323→
   324→/* ===== CARD STACK ACTIONS ===== */
   325→
   326→/** Return the currently expanded card, or null. */
   327→function getExpandedCard() {
   328→    return csCards.querySelector('.cs-card.cs-expanded') || null;
   329→}
   330→
   331→/** Disable every action button in the card stack. */
   332→function disableAllCardActions() {
   333→    csCards.querySelectorAll('.cs-action-btn').forEach(btn => { btn.disabled = true; });
   334→}
   335→
   336→/**
   337→ * Re-enable action buttons contextually:
   338→ * - Hide readability button if a readability card already exists.
   339→ * - Hide inspire button if an inspire card already exists.
   340→ * - Enable copy / send on all cards.
   341→ * Never enables buttons while streaming is active.
   342→ */
   343→function updateCardActionStates() {
   344→    if (csIsStreaming) return;
   345→
   346→    const cards = Array.from(csCards.querySelectorAll('.cs-card'));
   347→    const hasReadability = cards.some(c => c.dataset.type === 'readability');
   348→    const hasInspire     = cards.some(c => c.dataset.type === 'inspire');
   349→
   350→    cards.forEach(card => {
   351→        const readabilityBtn = card.querySelector('[data-action="readability"]');
   352→        const inspireBtn     = card.querySelector('[data-action="inspire"]');
   353→        const copyBtn        = card.querySelector('[data-action="copy"]');
   354→        const sendBtn        = card.querySelector('[data-action="send"]');
   355→
   356→        if (readabilityBtn) {
   357→            readabilityBtn.hidden   = hasReadability;
   358→            readabilityBtn.disabled = hasReadability;
   359→        }
   360→        if (inspireBtn) {
   361→            inspireBtn.hidden   = hasInspire;
   362→            inspireBtn.disabled = hasInspire;
   363→        }
   364→        if (copyBtn) copyBtn.disabled = false;
   365→        if (sendBtn) sendBtn.disabled = false;
   366→    });
   367→}
   368→
   369→/**
   370→ * Wire click handlers onto a fully-built card.
   371→ * Call this once per card after it is appended to the DOM.
   372→ */
   373→function setupCardActionHandlers(card) {
   374→    const textEl         = card.querySelector('.cs-card-text');
   375→    const readabilityBtn = card.querySelector('[data-action="readability"]');
   376→    const inspireBtn     = card.querySelector('[data-action="inspire"]');
   377→    const copyBtn        = card.querySelector('[data-action="copy"]');
   378→    const sendBtn        = card.querySelector('[data-action="send"]');
   379→
   380→    if (readabilityBtn) {
   381→        readabilityBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
   382→            const src = textEl.textContent.trim();
   383→            if (src) runCardStreamProcess(src, '/api/v1/readability', 'readability', 'Readability');
   384→        });
   385→    }
   386→
   387→    if (inspireBtn) {
   388→        inspireBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
   389→            const src = textEl.textContent.trim();
   390→            if (src) runCardStreamProcess(src, '/api/v1/correctness', 'inspire', 'Inspire');
   391→        });
   392→    }
   393→
   394→    if (copyBtn) {
   395→        copyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
   396→            // Copy the expanded (primary) card's text
   397→            const expanded = getExpandedCard();
   398→            const target   = expanded
   399→                ? expanded.querySelector('.cs-card-text').textContent.trim()
   400→                : textEl.textContent.trim();
   401→            if (!target) return;
   402→            const origLabel = copyBtn.textContent;
   403→            const finish = () => {
   404→                copyBtn.textContent = 'Copied!';
   405→                setTimeout(() => { copyBtn.textContent = origLabel; }, 2000);
   406→            };
   407→            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
   408→                navigator.clipboard.writeText(target).then(finish).catch(() => {
   409→                    _fallbackCopy(target);
   410→                    finish();
   411→                });
   412→            } else {
   413→                _fallbackCopy(target);
   414→                finish();
   415→            }
   416→        });
   417→    }
   418→
   419→    if (sendBtn) {
   420→        sendBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
   421→            // Send the expanded (primary) card's text to Slack webhook
   422→            const expanded   = getExpandedCard();
   423→            const targetText = expanded
   424→                ? expanded.querySelector('.cs-card-text').textContent.trim()
   425→                : textEl.textContent.trim();
   426→            if (!targetText) return;
   427→            sendBtn.disabled = true;
   428→            await sendMessage(targetText, 'brainstorm');
   429→            sendBtn.textContent = 'Sent ✓';
   430→            sendBtn.disabled    = false;
   431→            setTimeout(() => { sendBtn.textContent = 'Send'; }, 2000);
   432→        });
   433→    }
   434→}
   435→
   436→/** textarea-based clipboard fallback for browsers without navigator.clipboard. */
   437→function _fallbackCopy(text) {
   438→    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
   439→    ta.value = text;
   440→    ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:-9999px;left:-9999px;opacity:0';
   441→    document.body.appendChild(ta);
   442→    ta.focus();
   443→    ta.select();
   444→    try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (_) {}
   445→    document.body.removeChild(ta);
   446→}

   448→/**
   449→ * Stream an LLM endpoint into a new card, then re-enable action buttons.
   450→ * Enforces a maximum of 3 cards by removing the oldest collapsed card first.
   451→ */
   452→async function runCardStreamProcess(sourceText, endpoint, type, label) {
   453→    if (csIsStreaming) return;
   454→
   455→    // Cap at 3 total cards: remove oldest collapsed card if needed

ASSISTANTMESSAGE #97
The JS syntax is clean. The test failures are all pre-existing (pytest-asyncio isn't installed properly, missing Python module dependencies). None of them test our frontend changes. Let me now do a final review of the implementation to make sure everything is correct: 1. ✅ `buildCard` uses unique IDs (`cs-card-${++csCardCounter}`) 2. ✅ Transcript cards get readability + inspire buttons; other cards only get copy + send 3. ✅ `showCardStack` calls `setupCardActionHandlers` and `updateCardActionStates` 4. ✅ `setupCardActionHandlers` wires: readability → `runCardStreamProcess`, inspire → `runCardStreamProcess`, copy → clipboard, send → sendMessage + Sent ✓ 5. ✅ `runCardStreamProcess` disables all buttons during streaming and shows a pulsing cursor animation 6. ✅ Card stack is capped at 3 by removing the oldest collapsed card before adding new ones 7. ✅ `updateCardActionStates` hides readability and inspire buttons when those card types already exist 8. ✅ Clipboard fallback is handled for older browsers 9. ✅ Copy and Send operations target the expanded card when available Now I need to verify that `setupCardActionHandlers` is wired up correctly in all the right places. The event listeners are attached to the new card before it gets expanded, which is fine since we're just setting them up, not triggering them. Then `updateCardActionStates` runs in the finally block after streaming completes and `csIsStreaming` is set to false, so buttons get re-enabled at that point. The buttons start disabled when the card is created, and they stay disabled until the finally block runs—that's the intended flow. One thing to check: when a card is collapsed, its body is hidden with CSS, so even if someone somehow clicked a button on a collapsed card, it wouldn't be accessible anyway. The logic checks out. Time to push this branch and open a PR.

ASSISTANTMESSAGE #114
## Status DONE ## What Changed - **`static/main.js`** — Added `csCardCounter` + `csIsStreaming` state variables; modified `buildCard` to use unique counter-based IDs and conditionally render Readability/Inspire buttons (transcript cards only); updated `showCardStack` to call `setupCardActionHandlers` + `updateCardActionStates`; added 6 new functions: `getExpandedCard`, `disableAllCardActions`, `updateCardActionStates`, `setupCardActionHandlers`, `_fallbackCopy`, and `runCardStreamProcess` - **`static/style.css`** — Added `.cs-card-text.cs-streaming::after` blinking block-cursor keyframe animation for streaming state ## Key Decisions - **Copy/Send target the expanded card** — since action buttons are in the card body (hidden when collapsed), clicking them always operates on the expanded card; the handlers resolve the expanded card at click-time - **`setupCardActionHandlers` called before streaming starts** on new cards — handlers are registered early but buttons stay `disabled` until `updateCardActionStates` runs in `finally` - **`csIsStreaming` guard** prevents re-entrant streaming if a button somehow fires while a stream is active - **Cap at 3 cards** — when ≥3 cards exist, the oldest collapsed card is removed before the new card is appended ## PR / Branch - Branch: `feature/frg-270-card-stack-streaming-copy-send` - PR: https://github.com/chillkimtest-oss/hey-chill-v2/pull/8
